architecture.output: 120 residual logits added to log(formal v312 probability)
architecture.initialization: final residual layer exactly zero so initial prediction equals v312

features.race: 12 frozen v310 race columns + course race sidecar, with missing indicators

large_improvement.relative_description: approximately 0.27% or greater at v312 logloss scale
